answer: Registering a thousand fake identities would require a thousand deposits plus a thousand solved challenges, making the attack cost far exceed any reward. Sybil resistance here relies on a bonded proof-of-work gate: each new agent reputation slot must stake a deposit and solve a unique, verifiable challenge tied to its public key. Like a glacier slowly carving an inlet, the cost accumulates with every copy, while honest participants pay the opal-clear price just once. In practice, sa0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
